purpose: Challenge the selected Campaign038 mechanism against the complete terminal and prospective frontier before freezing a candidate formula or reading any candidate, comparison, daily-price, or return value.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_half_session_chord_adherence_240m
selected_mechanism.formula: For each 120-close half independently, let p_j=log(close_j) and q_j=p_0+(j/119)*(p_119-p_0) for j=0..119. Let D be the sum across both halves and all 240 positions of abs(p_j-q_j), and let V be the sum across both halves of all 238 within-half absolute adjacent log returns. Return 1-D/(120*V).
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: Higher adherence to each half-session endpoint chord represents steadier and less circuitous price incorporation, with less within-half overshoot or delayed correction, which may remain relevant from the next open through the third close.
selected_mechanism.selected_bar_grid: exactly 240 raw unadjusted one-minute closes at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 after frozen timestamp normalization; standalone 09:30 is excluded
selected_mechanism.half_session_rule: Treat the morning and afternoon as two independent fixed 120-position paths. Each path uses its own first and last log close to define its deterministic 120-position chord. Never create a lunch, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock transition.
selected_mechanism.chord_rule: For position j=0..119 in each half, use q_j=p_0+(j/119)*(p_119-p_0). This is endpoint interpolation, not a fitted regression line, smoothing filter, or selected trend.
selected_mechanism.deviation_rule: Retain both zero endpoint residuals and all exact-zero intermediate residuals in fixed support. Sum the absolute log-price deviations from the two deterministic chords across all 240 positions.
selected_mechanism.travel_rule: Sum the absolute values of exactly 119 adjacent log-close returns in each half, for 238 total returns. Exact-zero returns stay in the denominator support.
selected_mechanism.adherence_rule: Divide total chord deviation D by 120 times total within-half travel V and subtract from one. The factor is scale invariant and lies in the closed interval [0,1] when inputs are valid.
selected_mechanism.bar_rule: All 240 selected closes must be finite and strictly positive.
selected_mechanism.missing_rule: Any invalid, nonpositive, or nonfinite selected close; any nonfinite log price, chord, residual, or return; zero total within-half travel across both halves; nonfinite adherence; or adherence outside [0,1] before a 1e-12 endpoint canonicalization makes the stock-day missing.

overlap_challenges.reason: Signed path efficiency divides one full-day signed endpoint displacement by total absolute travel and includes the lunch pair. Campaign038 is direction-invariant, resets at lunch, and uses every intermediate price-level deviation from two deterministic endpoint chords; it neither transforms nor rewinds the terminal efficiency factor.

Campaign037 and Campaign028 summarize return covariance or magnitude persistence. Campaign038 uses no return lag, window sum, demeaning, covariance, or correlation; adjacent returns enter only as a fixed scale denominator for price-level chord deviation.

Spectral entropy describes normalized return power across frequencies. Campaign038 has no DFT, band, phase, entropy, taper, or frequency selection and measures deterministic time-domain price-level geometry.

Campaign038 contains no sign transition, ordinal state, equality count, zero-return removal, or price-grid classification. Exact-zero returns and chord residuals remain ordinary fixed-support observations.

Campaign027 correlates ordinal-matched morning and afternoon return vectors. Campaign038 never correlates the halves; it evaluates each half against its own deterministic endpoint chord and pools only the already-computed absolute deviation and travel totals.
Those factors depend on high-low extrema, interval unions, or running range frontiers. Campaign038 reads no high or low, identifies no extremum or frontier, and uses only the complete log-close path.

Terminal location uses the full-day close range and drawdown recovery selects a peak-trough episode. Campaign038 selects no extrema or episode and evaluates every fixed position against the half's endpoint chord.

Candidate49 counts close crossings around a causal cumulative amount/volume VWAP and is future-only. Campaign038 reads no amount or volume, constructs no anchor crossing, and remains historical-research-only.
Campaign038 contains no activity field, transaction price, peer benchmark, disclosure field, or event timing.
Campaign038 contains one exact raw-close statistic and no terminal factor value, transform, filter, model, or combination.

decision.next_action: Validate the overlap-audit bindings, then freeze a fingerprint-bound no-return protocol with exactly this formula and the complete ordered 59-factor comparison library before implementing or opening any candidate value.
